threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still wait for the bus at stops, while locals just hop on the next train or walk. The right kind of impatience slowly seeps in.
Caught a late 333 last week, and a guy started singing ‘Sweet Caroline’ with the driver. Only in Brixton could you find a bus that doubles as karaoke.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I walked past the bakery at Sonnenallee, smelled fresh pastries, and heard a group of kids practicing breakdancing on the sidewalk.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg do you find a spontaneous street party with DJs, while just around the corner, a cozy café serves currywurst with vegan options.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can always tell by how they talk about BART delays; locals sigh in resignation, while newcomers act like it’s a surprise.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus picking up a guy in a tuxedo, still holding his champagne bottle. Only in the city do we class it up even on public transit.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often take selfies with the street musicians but miss the real vibe—Gràcia's best talent is often jamming on the corners, not the main squares.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their bewilderment at the tram schedule. They look confused as the trams seem to have a life of their own here.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still avoid the bike lanes during rush hour. Everyone else is doing a slalom around you, looking mildly entertained.
Caught a bloke singing opera on the 37 last night. Everyone was pretending not to listen, but the driver was loving it, tapping along.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was home when I saw the old man at the corner bakery arguing with the delivery guy over the last croissant. Pure Neukölln energy.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you find spontaneous barbecues in public parks, complete with improvised dance parties. It’s like community spirit in a bottle.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s from the Mission if they can spot a tourist by the way they fumble with the BART ticket machines during a meltdown.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a local artist rapping about Muni delays on the bus today—turns out nothing unites us like waiting for the 30 to show up.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think every bar has tapas, but many just serve vermut. A quiet afternoon can mean a full house; locals lounge, not rush.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their bewilderment at the ‘siesta’ silence creeping in around 3 PM, as locals vanish for a nap.
